name: Eszter Kovács
bio:
Eszter's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the meticulous world of aerodynamics. With a background in mechanical engineering from the Budapest University of Technology and Economics, she found herself drawn to the precision and problem-solving involved in wind tunnel testing. Her early career was spent at a research facility focused on automotive aerodynamics, where she honed her skills in data analysis and flow visualization.

Years later, Eszter sought a more dynamic environment. The allure of Formula One eventually drew her to Europe, where she worked her way through smaller teams before landing a position at Rahal Letterman Lanigan. Eszter approaches her role with a relentless pursuit of perfection, ensuring that every test is conducted with the utmost accuracy. Her ability to identify subtle airflow anomalies and translate them into actionable improvements for the car's design has made her a valuable asset to the team. She often says 'the devil is in the details, and the wind will always tell the truth'.

Eszter's distinctive edge lies in her ability to visualize complex aerodynamic phenomena. She brings an almost artistic approach to her work, creating detailed diagrams and visualizations that help engineers understand the flow patterns around the car. This unique skill has helped Rahal Letterman Lanigan gain a crucial edge in the competitive world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a practical bob, often with a few strands escaping her focus.
physical.description: Eszter has a thoughtful face framed by practical glasses, reflecting years of dedicated work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn aerodynamic sketches.
Insists on using a specific type of Hungarian paprika to season her lunch, even at the track.
Has a habit of talking to the wind tunnel equipment, referring to it by nicknames.
